content: Hi! How can I help you today? Looking to share your class notes or organize your PDFs?
Hi! Yes, I want to send my lecture notes and some scanned handouts to my study group. What's the best way to share them?

Great idea! I recommend creating a shared folder, maybe called 'History_Notes_Sem2'. You can upload your PDFs there and set the link to 'view only' for privacy. Would you like help setting up the folder?
Yes, please! Once I upload, should I just send everyone the link?
Exactly! Once you've uploaded, share the folder link with your group. Encourage them to click in and browse the files. If they want their own copies, they can simply download the PDFs.
Should I organize by topic or by week?
Organizing by week is usually easiest for classmates to follow. You can create folders like 'Week 1', 'Week 2', and add your files to each. A quick index file can also help everyone browse.
Just finished uploading! Is there a way to check if the files uploaded correctly?
Absolutely! Click through the folder and preview each file to make sure everything is readable. You can also invite a friend to visit the folder and confirm they can open and download the notes.
Good idea. Should I allow downloads or just view access?
View access is safest for editing, but allowing downloads is helpful if classmates want to study offline. You can set the link so they can browse and download the originals, but not edit them.
Perfect, I'll send the link and instructions to my group now.
Wonderful! Remind them to click into the 'History_Notes_Sem2' folder, browse by week, and download any files they need. Let me know if you'd like tips on keeping everything organized, great teamwork!
